task_context.problem_statement:
The Razorback t-shirt shop makes $ 98 dollars off each t-shirt sold. During the Arkansas game and the Texas tech game they sold a total of 163 t-shirts. If they sold 89 t-shirts during the Arkansas game
How much money did they make from selling the t-shirts during the arkansas game?
( 98.0 * 89.0 )
